Good news - this issue has been fixed\!

The comments on this issue are correct: there was a regression in SAP AI Core Deployments mode that was fixed in PR #7675, which was merged on November 26th and released in **v3.39.0** (December 2nd). The fix addressed stream processing issues for different chunk formats (Buffer, string, byte arrays) and improved error handling for streaming responses.

**You're on v3.34.1 - updating to v3.45.1 (the latest release) should resolve your issue.**

For reference, here's what happened:
- The regression was introduced around v3.32.x/v3.34.x and particularly worsened in v3.36.x (as noted by @Dopaemin and @ricardosantossap in the comments)
- @schardosin submitted the fix in #7675
- @lizzzcai and @qswangsap confirmed the fix works on v3.38.3+

If the issue persists after updating, one thing to note: when working with very large files (500+ lines to write or large PDFs like 50+ pages), you may also run into context window limits rather than streaming issues. If you see errors after updating, it would help the maintainers to know:
- Whether Orchestration Mode is enabled or disabled
- The exact error message format (to distinguish between streaming vs. context length issues)

| SME | Reason |
|-----|--------|
| @lizzzcai | SAP AI Core maintainer, confirmed the fix |
| @schardosin | Authored the fix in PR #7675 |
| @yuvalman | Primary contributor to SAP AI Core provider |

**Possible Duplicates**
- #7367 (closed) - "SAP AI Core streaming inference requests fail" - Same root cause, fixed by #7675
- #7597 (open) - "Latest VS Code Cline extension using SAP AI Core still fails" - Same fix applies
- #7457 (closed) - "SAPAICore Provider issue on Claude 4.5 sonnet with Orchestration Mode disabled" - Same root cause
- #6516 (open) - "Free cline models crash with Invalid API Response" - SAP AI Core users in comments had same issue

Model ID : Something like "qwen/qwen3.5-9b"
